remarks: Incredible opportunity to own a turn-key ranch on 13.5 acres with a large private pond, in beautiful South Wales! Modern look with a cabin feel. 10 mins from the Village of East Aurora, and minutes from Rt.16 or Rt.20A, making for easy commute to anywhere! This home offers amazing nature with fully updated and modern conveniences. 13.5 mostly wooded acres, complete with trails for walking or ATV’s, well established wildlife, and a stocked pond allows for any outdoor recreation activity to be easy and enjoyable! Enter the home into a large living room space with high vaulted ceilings, exploding with natural light from the large bay windows and new skylight. New flooring and all new light fixtures throughout the home makes each room flow into the next (2025). Eat-in kitchen also has vaulted ceilings, natural wood beams, and sliding glass doors leading to the expansive back lot and pond, gives this room an open feel. Off the kitchen is a half bath with laundry and the homes mechanicals. For the utilities, you’ll find a new natural high efficiency gas boiler (2025), new tankless HWH (2025), and a new water purification system (2025). Very large primary bedroom, with 2 other generously sized bedrooms, all with great sized closets. Roof was a TTO and replacement in 2024, back wooden deck built in 2024. This amazing retreat would be perfect for the homeowner looking for great privacy and lots of nature. Don’t miss the opportunity to own a slice of paradise in the hills of South Wales!
